title: ze_ratatouille
description:
Follow the new ze maps here: 

 RATATOILLE 

 Map By [url= 

 The map is based on the movie Ratatouille and the game of the same name 
There are 3 levels on the map 

 Level 1 - Village: 

You will need to escape from this house. By moving books and wooden boxes, you can open your way. At the end of the level, you will have to climb into the pipe to escape from the zombies!

 

 Level 2 - Sewerage 

You got into the sewer, but it is heavily flooded with water. You will need to break through the pipes to lower the water level and escape from the zombies. At this level, you will have to fight the boss, the electric shield. If you fail to kill him, then the water gets on the bare wires of the electric shield, and you will die. Be careful, because during the boss battle, the wooden pallets you are standing on may sink into the water! At the end of the level, you will enter the kitchen through a hole in the sink, where you will need to hide in a box before it closes

 

 Level 3 - Kitchen 

You found yourself in the Gusto restaurant. You have to explore this restaurant and fight the final boss

 

Special thanks to the Net4all server for testing this map

 
If you find bugs on the map, then write to me in discord: r1cko27
